notes.title: 2025/08/12 - a416
notes.notes:
- Reworked all input in the game
-- Most keys in the game can now be configured
- Fixed issues with updating from old game versions corrupting the game's settings
- Fixed multiplayer issues with syncing bullets
- Fixed "Friends only" hosting option sometimes causing a server to not show in the list
- Fixed small UI issue in the language selection menu
- Reworked how tasks (things running in the background) are run in BUILD mode
- Fixed some issues regarding the order in which actions are processed not working correctly with actions that use two keys
- Added a new tutorial system, called "Review" which allows you to view information on how a block works from within BUILD mode. Currently added for HUB and BLOCK- Other blocks are waiting on some issues with the system to be fixed

notes.title: 2025/05/18 (a415)
notes.notes: - Added LIMIT option for HYDRAULIC blocks

notes.title: 2025/05/09 (a414)
notes.notes:
Fixes several issues relating to combat in multiplayer, mainly:
- Fixed missiles launched from a LAUNCHER not synchronizing properly in multiplayer
- Fixed missiles not exploding correctly in multiplayer
- Fixed RADAR block not functioning correctly in multiplayer

notes.title: 2025/04/10 (a413)
notes.notes:
- Adds WIP RADAR block - This is to gather feedback on it's behavior.
It allows for LAUNCHER blocks to lock onto certain targets.
- Adds the ability to select which players can view your multiplayer server, Everyone, or Friends only.
- Add support for multiple teams in multiplayer, although it currently cannot be enabled in servers.

notes.title: 30/07/2024 (a356)
notes.notes:
- Fix performance issues in Multiplayer

- Updated main island map
- Added a new setting for joints that reduces a joint's effect on the main body

* Only translated in English

- Small localization changes
- Added Discord button to Main Menu

- You can now assign a color to a group in the keybind menu

- Ability to move keybinds between groups by holding SHIFT

- Fixed issues in UI that scrolls

- Fixed small bugs with AIM DEVICE

notes.title: 2024/02/24 - a320
notes.notes:

- Fixed issue where builds would lag upon spawning

- Add SNAP function when editing a block
